scripts.name: STRATUS - AZURE - Elevate to User Access Administrator at Root Scope
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for Azure.

Elevate to User Access Administrator at Root Scope

Elevates the current principal to the User Access Administrator role at root scope (/), by abusing the "Access management for Azure resources" capability available to Global Administrators in Entra ID. This technique allows a Global Administrator to gain control over all Azure subscriptions and management groups in the tenant, enabling arbitrary role assignments across all Azure resources. Warm-up: None Detonation: - Call the elevateAccess REST API endpoint, which assigns the User Access Adminis

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Elevate to User Access Administrator at Root Scope
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_azure_subscription}" ]; then export AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID="#{stratus_azure_subscription}"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=azure.privilege-escalation.root-user-access-administrator"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate azure.privilege-escalation.root-user-access-administrator
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=azure.privilege-escalation.root-user-access-administrator"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"azure.privilege-escalation.root-user-access-administrator\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup azure.privilege-escalation.root-user-access-administrator
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=azure.privilege-escalation.root-user-access-administrator"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT
